description: This file defines the PHP class 'requirement_mgr', which manages requirements within the TestLink open-source testing management system. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, importing/exporting, and managing requirements, along with related functionalities such as custom fields, attachments, and test coverage.

classes.name: requirement_mgr
classes.description: A PHP class managing requirements in TestLink, allowing creation, modification, deletion, import/export, and handling related features such as custom fields, attachments, and test coverage relationships.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the requirement_mgr object with database reference and setting up related managers and configuration.

methods.name: get_export_file_types
methods.description: Returns a map of supported export file types.

methods.name: get_import_file_types
methods.description: Returns a map of supported import file types.

methods.name: get_by_id
methods.description: Fetches requirement details by ID, with options for specific versions and output levels.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new requirement, optionally with an initial version.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing requirement's attributes and optionally creates a new revision.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes requirement(s), optionally including all versions and related data.

methods.name: get_coverage
methods.description: Retrieves the test coverage for a given requirement.

methods.name: check_basic_data
methods.description: Performs basic validation checks on requirement data before creation or update.

methods.name: set_order
methods.description: Changes the display order of requirements within a hierarchy.

methods.name: exportReqToXML
methods.description: Exports a requirement to an XML string, optionally including attachments.

methods.name: createFromXML
methods.description: Creates requirements from an XML representation.

methods.name: createFromMap
methods.description: Creates requirements from a data map, supporting custom fields and attachments.

methods.name: xmlToMapRequirement
methods.description: Parses an XML item into a requirement data map.

methods.name: html_table_of_custom_field_inputs
methods.description: Generates HTML for custom field input elements.

methods.name: html_table_of_custom_field_values
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying custom field values.

methods.name: values_to_db
methods.description: Writes custom field values to the database.

methods.name: customFieldValuesAsXML
methods.description: Returns custom field values related to a requirement as XML.

methods.name: processAttachments
methods.description: Handles processing and importing attachments for requirements.

methods.name: getByDocIDInProject
methods.description: Retrieves requirements associated with a document ID within a specific project, optionally filtered by parent ID and other options.

methods.name: getByIDBulkLatestVersionRevision
methods.description: Fetches the latest version and revision info for one or multiple requirement IDs, returning a map with requirement details and associated user info.

methods.name: getCoverageCounter
methods.description: Counts the number of coverage entries for a specific requirement ID.

methods.name: getCoverageCounterSet
methods.description: Returns coverage counts for a set of requirement IDs.

methods.name: getRelationsCounters
methods.description: Retrieves counters for requirement relations, summarizing incoming and outgoing links.

methods.name: updateScope
methods.description: Updates the scope field of a requirement version.

methods.name: renderImageAttachments
methods.description: Generates inline images for attachments in requirement descriptions.

methods.name: inlineImageProcessing
methods.description: Processes inline images within requirement scope/content.

methods.name: monitorOn
methods.description: Adds a requirement to the monitoring list for a user and project.

methods.name: monitorOff
methods.description: Removes a user’s monitoring of a requirement, with optional scope to project.

methods.name: getMonitoredByUser
methods.description: Retrieves a list of requirements monitored by a specific user within a project, with optional filtering.

methods.name: getReqMonitors
methods.description: Fetches users monitoring a specific requirement, returning either a map or array.

methods.name: notifyMonitors
methods.description: Sends email notifications to all users monitoring a requirement about an action performed.

methods.name: getMonitorMailCfg
methods.description: Returns email template configuration based on notification action.

methods.name: setNotifyOn
methods.description: Configures notification settings.

methods.name: getNotifyOn
methods.description: Retrieves current notification configuration.

methods.name: updateCoverage
methods.description: Updates test coverage for requirement versions, optionally freezing previous versions.

methods.name: updateTCVLinkStatus
methods.description: Updates the link status of a test case version in relation to requirement versions.

methods.name: getAllReqVersionIDForReq
methods.description: Fetches all requirement and version ID pairs for a set of requirement IDs.

methods.name: getActiveForTCVersion
methods.description: Retrieves active requirements for a specific test case version ID.

methods.name: getGoodForTCVersion
methods.description: Retrieves 'good' requirements for a test case version ID, possibly with verbose details.

methods.name: getActiveForReqVersion
methods.description: Retrieves active requirements for a specific requirement version ID.

methods.name: delReqVersionTCVersionLink
methods.description: Removes the link between a requirement version and test case version.

methods.name: delReqVersionTCVersionLinkByID
methods.description: Deletes a requirement-to-test-case version link by link ID, with audit logging.

methods.name: getLatestReqVersionCoverageCounterSet
methods.description: Provides coverage counters for requirements using latest requirement version IDs.

methods.name: bulkAssignLatestREQVTCV
methods.description: Bulk assigns latest requirement versions to test case versions.

methods.name: assignReqVerToTCVer
methods.description: Assigns a requirement version to a test case version, creating a link.

methods.name: getGoodForReqVersion
methods.description: Retrieves requirements considered 'good' for a specific requirement version, with optional verbosity.
